Amazing dark chocolate box. Perfect for a small gift.
The almond butter was stale and disappointing, with poor texture.
Protein granola is fine for breakfast, but not very crunchy.
Excellent olive oil with a fresh peppery finish.
Good honey jar, tasty in tea and easy to use.
Worst chips I tried this month. The bag tasted stale and bad.
Good pasta pack that cooks evenly and holds sauce well.
The treats smell fresh and our dog loves them.
Herbal infusion is neutral and mild, good for evenings.
Breakfast cereal arrived broken and tasted stale.
Love this tea. It is fresh, tasty, and excellent after lunch.
